retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast silhouette of a figure against a glowing sun and warm gradient background, featuring bold, stylized 1970s display typography centered over the dark subject.
triggerTerms: bold white display type on dark silhouette
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, featureless silhouette of a person positioned centrally against a large, soft-edged white sun, set within a warm orange-to-red gradient background with a heavy film grain texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject silhouette acts as a dark canvas for white typography
Large circular sun provides a halo effect behind the head and shoulders
Warm background gradient contrasts with the stark black foreground
Grainy texture unifies the photographic and typographic elements
coreInvariants: Total black silhouette of the primary subject
Large, glowing circular light source behind the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, medium-close-up silhouette occupying the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white sun centered behind the subject's head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright sun down to the high-contrast white text in the center of the silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The orange gradient background surrounding the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for the silhouette and foreground.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the sun and the typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange and reddish-pink for the background gradient.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black silhouette and white elements; high saturation in the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric, heavy display face with rounded terminals and stylized counters.
letterConstructionRules: Stylized, often circular or semi-circular counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'B', 'R', and 'A' feature distinct, rounded internal cutouts
The 'S' has a tight, symmetrical curve

composition.position: Centered on the chest area of the silhouette
composition.overlap: Fully contained within the black silhouette

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in varying sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, geometric 70s aesthetic.
Similar heavy geometric construction and rounded terminals.
Captures the geometric and stylized counter shapes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast silhouette of a person from the chest up against a large, glowing white sun. The background should be a grainy orange-to-red gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered, bold, white 1970s-style display text over the black silhouette area.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and solid white?
Is there a visible film grain texture?
Is the sun glowing behind the subject's head?

mustAchieve: High contrast between silhouette and text
Soft glow on the sun element
avoid: Visible facial details in the silhouette

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the black silhouette
Verify the sun does not wash out the text
Check that the grain is consistent across the image
Confirm the color palette remains warm and retro
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouette Subject + Glowing Sun + Warm Grainy Gradient + Bold 70s Display Type
